confidence_rationale: Tse et al. is the canonical demonstration that a pre-existing associative schema lets new cue-value associations consolidate from hippocampus to neocortex (mPFC) in days rather than weeks -- a single-trial paired-associate can become hippocampus-independent within 48 h once a schema exists. This is the mechanistic core MECH-189 needs for its persistence/cue-indexing half: a cue-indexed associative store into which salient value-laden contacts are rapidly written and stabilised, with the mPFC carrying the consolidated schema. It directly addresses the durability gap exposed by the Rovee-Collier entry -- schema-assisted consolidation is HOW a labile early trace becomes a stable anchor. Confidence 0.62: high source quality (Science, elegant within-animal design, mPFC role confirmed by a sibling 2011 study) but the schema content is spatial flavour-place association in adult rats, not developmental goal-value anchors, and a known cost (schema scaffolding trades item-level memory specificity over time) is a live caveat for cue-indexed retrieval.
failure_signatures: Rapid schema-assisted consolidation requires a PRE-EXISTING schema; the first associations into a novel schema consolidate slowly and remain hippocampus-dependent. MECH-189's bootstrap (empty store -> complexity=1.0 -> first contacts write) is the moment BEFORE any schema exists -- so the earliest super-ordinal anchors should be the slowest and least stable, not the most. The substrate writes them at full strength immediately, which over-states early-anchor stability relative to this evidence.

Schemas accelerate integration at the cost of memory specificity over time (the consolidated trace generalises and loses item detail). If super-ordinal anchors generalise the same way, their cue-index keys drift toward the schema centroid, and READ retrieval in a novel context may pull z_goal toward an over-general anchor rather than a context-appropriate one.

mapping.source_claim_statement: When new information fits a pre-established associative schema, systems consolidation is dramatically accelerated: in rats with a well-learned flavour-place schema, new flavour-place paired associates learned in a single trial became hippocampus-independent within 48 h (vs the usual weeks). The medial prefrontal cortex is required for schema-based assimilation, and schema-consistent learning up-regulates immediate-early genes in mPFC.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-189 needs a biological mechanism by which a salient, cue-associated contact is rapidly written into a persistent, cortically-held store keyed by context. Tse et al. supply it: a cue-indexed associative schema, hippocampally encoded and mPFC-consolidated, into which new cue-value associations are rapidly and durably integrated. This is the consolidation step that converts Rovee-Collier's labile infant trace into a stable super-ordinal anchor; the mPFC/vmPFC schema is the biological seat of the cross-episode-persistent goal hierarchy the substrate models as SuperOrdinalGoalMemory (the design doc names hippocampal-vmPFC goal-anchor formation explicitly).
mapping.mapping_caveat: The schema content is spatial flavour-place association in adult rats, not affect-tagged goal anchors, and not developmental. The transfer assumes (i) value/goal associations consolidate by the same schema mechanism as flavour-place ones, and (ii) the adult-rat schema process is the right model for child-phase anchor formation. Two specific tensions: schema-assisted speed REQUIRES a pre-existing schema (the substrate's bootstrap writes the first anchors before any schema exists), and schema scaffolding trades item specificity over time (risking over-general anchor keys). Mapping is to the consolidation MECHANISM CLASS, not to a measured goal-anchor result.
mapping.source_context: Adult Long-Evans rats; flavour-place paired-associate task in an event arena; lesion + IEG + within-animal consolidation-rate design. Species: rat. Modality: behavioural lesion + molecular. mPFC role corroborated by Tse et al. 2011 (schema-dependent gene activation in neocortex).

confidence_components.notes: Source quality high (Science, elegant design, replicated mPFC role). Mapping fidelity moderate -- it cleanly grounds the cue-indexed rapid-consolidation mechanism and the mPFC/vmPFC anchor seat, but on spatial not goal-value content. Transfer risk moderate-high: the spatial->value, adult->developmental, and pre-existing-schema-required vs bootstrap-from-empty mismatches are all live.
